intent: Recorded bounded training/evaluation protocol; the verified FP32 artifact is now the selected app default.
taxonomy: 151 Kanto National Dex species, exact bundled labels order. Shiny and named regional forms collapse to base species; no form-level claims.
grouping: Before split: same source filename/pose, OOD species ID, byte/pixel hashes, white-cropped pHash/mirror Hamming<=6 connected components; quarantine label conflicts. Automated grouping can miss shared artwork/session identity.
split: Seed 20261027; per-species positive group 70/15/15 train/val/test_public, unknown groups split val/test by source; no source-published split is trusted.
baseline_exposure: Comparison-model exposure to portions of the public data is known or unresolved; public diagnostics do not prove independent camera superiority.
optimization: AdamW weight_decay .01, cosine schedule, label smoothing .05, BF16 autocast, grad clip5. Fixed seed and epoch-boundary checkpoints. Existing Windows torch2.13.0+cu132/torchvision0.28.0; no environment upgrade.
bounded_followup: At most one promising winner continuation for <=12 more epochs at lr .0001; or one higher-resolution trial only if validation error evidence justifies it. No unbounded sweep.
selection: Best checkpoint by positive validation top1, tie smaller artifact then macro recall. Architecture/followup/threshold choices recorded and SHA-bound before opening test_public predictions.
unknown_policy: Keep shipped baseline confidence>=.25 AND raw logit margin>=.5 for fair reference. Candidate diagnostic threshold/temperature chosen on val+ood_val only, then frozen. A 151-way score is not a trained unknown detector.
evaluation: Identical original images, center-square RGB white alpha and bilinear resolution-specific resize. PIL/CoreGraphics pixel parity pending Apple dump harness. Top1/3/5 macro recall/F1 per class confusion NLL Brier ECE acceptance coverage/FAR; 1000 paired group bootstrap samples. COCO128 is a small nonrepresentative diagnostic, not iPhone camera evidence.
export: Export separate packages into fresh folders; the selected default is the validated FP32 package. Other precisions require full numerical and device validation.
promotion_gates: Paired meaningful accuracy improvement with uncertainty and unknown-input performance
Source rights reviewed for intended redistribution
Physical target iPhone p50/p95/cold/warm/sustained latency memory thermal and operation placement evidence
